about: sha1 (first 12 hex) of every kit the lab has shipped, oldest first; CRLF read as LF, kit.js without its first // generated line. A unit whose src/kit.ts (or bp/scripts/kit.js) has one of these was never edited, so the build makes it the newest one (the last) by itself. tests/kit-offline.mjs --fix adds the current kit.
